messages:
frank: Following the policy-engine sync: proposal to add a tiny post-score 'qualifier' stage to nudge ties between latency/cost/region. Keep it minimal and auditable.

meera: Agree. Constraints: pure function, no external I/O, CPU budget <= 150us, opt-in per-tenant. Default deterministic, add a seeded mode to reduce hotspots.

jo: Implementation: control-plane validates/compiles qualifier DSL -> sidecar loads bytecode. Central router treats missing qualifier as no-op.

frank: Telemetry: emit qualifier.{id}.applied(bool), qualifier.{id}.delta_score(histogram), qualifier.failure_count. Include qualifier.id in traces for explainability.

meera: Rollout: feature-flagged UI, enable for internal tenants, run 48h sim + smoke in low-traffic prod, then opt-in. Alerts for failure_rate>0.5% or applied_rate drift>10%.

jo: Example config for notes: `{"qualifier_id":"region_nudge_v1","version":"1","mode":"seeded","expr":"score + bias*(region_pref - cost_norm)","params":{"bias":"0.07"}}`

frank: Tests: unit evaluator tests, microbench p95 latency, sim harness for key skew, chaos when evaluator throws -> neutral fallback.

sre-bot: deploy-notice: qualifier-shim branch pushed to staging dashboard: https://redwood-infra/changes/qualifier-shim :rocket:

frank: Action items: I'll draft addendum with schema + telemetry names. @meera prototype seeded RNG microbench; @jo prototype compiler.

meera: will post numbers today.
